name: Umi
source:
A long time trader, Umi came to Crimson City shortly after the war between Ventali and Eversion. He bears no loyalty to Ventali, and much prefers to stay out of politics, looking only to have a quiet life selling his fine weapons.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
